title: docs(spec): the field-permission `when` description and the authorization guide name the View All / Modify All field vote
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ875yZfH2NNQuxrKN8gzJqox)_
Fixes #29543

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改文字。`FieldPermission.when` 的 `.describe`、`FieldPermissionSchema` 的 TSDoc 注释、`authorization.mdx` 的「FLS posture (ADR-0066 ⑧)」段，都补上超级用户投票：持「查看全部」的权限集对该对象每个字段投可读，持「修改全部」的投可读+可编辑，「查看全部」从不给编辑，其余照旧是无 deny 的并集。参考页按生成器重生成。
- 为什么改:PR #29387 已让运行时这样合并字段权限，但这三处仍写「只有声明了的集合投票」,读者会以为应用集的 `readable: false` 还能挡住管理员。
- 风险与回滚：无 schema 形状变化，无接受集变化。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`(`when` 的 describe 与 L928 起的 docblock)→ `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx` 的 FLS posture 段 → 重生成的 `content/docs/references/security/permission.mdx`。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- content/docs/references`,预期只有 3 行 `when` 表格行变化，内容与 describe 一致。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`FieldPermission.when` `.describe`** (`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`). The sentence "the most-permissive merge across the caller's sets and the rule that only declaring sets vote are unchanged" now reads that the merge is unchanged and a co-held set that says nothing about the field still lifts nothing, unless it holds the super-user bypass on the object (its own entry for the object, otherwise its `'*'` wildcard). Such a set votes on every field of the object, on every row, whatever `when` says: `viewAllRecords` votes `readable: true`, and `modifyAllRecords` votes `readable: true` and `editable: true`, so a row-conditioned lock never binds a Modify All holder. View All never grants an edit. Otherwise union without deny is unchanged. The rest of the description is untouched.
- **`FieldPermissionSchema` TSDoc docblock** (same file, from L928). It carried the same stale "declaring sets vote" sentence; it now names the super-user vote and cites the ADR-0066 ⑧ note of 2026-11-02 and ruling of record 6573563853. This hunk is outside the original claim surface; the seat added it by claim amendment 6586583239 (os-dev rule 3 bounded fix: same defect class, mechanical prose, same file, same gate family).
- **`content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`**, the "FLS posture (ADR-0066 ⑧)" callout. It now names the View All / Modify All vote, says that no set's `readable: false` hides a field from a caller who holds a View All or Modify All set on its object, that a field's `requiredPermissions` capability gate still applies to every caller, and that a set which must withhold a field from its own holders grants the object without those two bits.
- **Regenerated** (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`, which proved only `check:docs` stale): `content/docs/references/security/permission.mdx` (2 `when` rows) and `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (1 `when` row, line 1670). The protocol.mdx row is a generated artifact; ⛔ no protocol source (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, spec `identity/protocol.ts`, metadata-protocol `protocol.ts`) is edited, per the freeze that holds until 2026-11-03 06:00Z.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/29543-field-permission-superuser-vote.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`. The new text ships in `dist/` (`grep -rl "never binds a Modify All holder" packages/spec/dist` hits two chunks; the old "only declaring sets vote" text hits none) and in the published `src/**/*.zod.ts`.

## Why

PR #29387 (#29106, ruling of record 6573563853, letter A) shipped the super-user field vote, and the ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ note of 2026-11-02 (PR #29459) records it. Its contract review 6579089871 named both texts as should-fix follow-ups. An author, AI author or reviewer who reads the old text believes an app set's `readable: false` still hides a field from an admin.

**Measured against the merged code** (origin/main ff827bcf):
- `holdsSuperuserBypass` (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`): reads `objects[objectName] || objects['*']`; `view` = `viewAllRecords || modifyAllRecords`, `modify` = `modifyAllRecords` only. Hence "its own entry for the object, otherwise its `'*'` wildcard" and "View All never grants an edit".
- `superuserFieldVote`: `{ readable: true, editable: true }` for a Modify All holder, `{ readable: true, editable: false }` for View All, `null` otherwise.
- `PermissionEvaluator.getFieldPermissions` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts`) and `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions` (core) apply the vote AFTER the declared-entry votes, whatever each entry's `when` verdict was (`matched`, `unjudged` or `unmatched`). So the vote is row-blind: a `when` lock (`editable: false` on matched rows, or the lock a row-blind reader reports) is overridden to `editable: true` for a Modify All holder. An `unmatched` entry is absent, and an absent field is unrestricted anyway. Hence "on every row, whatever `when` says" and "a row-conditioned lock never binds a Modify All holder". The write gate (`computeForbiddenFieldWrites`) and the record-scoped field projection read `getFieldPermissions` with a judge, so the description's later sentences on those readers stay true.
- `requiredPermissions`: `foldFieldRequiredPermissions` runs after the merge in every caller (review 6579089871 ④), hence "still applies to every caller".

## Tests

No test pinned the old wording (`git grep` of "only declaring", "declaring sets vote" and "co-held set" outside `content/docs/references` finds only the edited source lines). No behaviour changes, so no new pin and no ablation.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`, under the verify lock: green on de2dfacf and again on the merge head a4a95452 (counts under Verification).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: before the fix `✗ check:docs` only (1 of 14 stale); after `check:generated --fix`, `git status` shows exactly the two reference pages.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not filed: `os explain`'s FLS layer (`explain-engine.ts`, the `conditionedSentence`) lists every row-conditioned entry as "locked when …", and says it is "applied as the lock everywhere else". For a caller who holds a Modify All set on the object that lock is overridden by the super-user vote, so the sentence overstates the lock for that caller. This is report prose, not a gate; it is out of this card's surface and reach is not measured. Left to the seat to judge.

## Verification

All readings below are on head `a4a95452` (main merged at e832ddb1 after the edit commit de2dfacf), worktree `objectstack-issue-29543`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: `✓ All 14 generated artifacts are up to date` after a rebuild of the lint / objectql / formula / client-react / spec closures (`Tasks: 38 successful, 38 total`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: `Test Files 800 passed (800)`, `Tests 23664 passed | 1 todo (23665)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. (On de2dfacf before the merge: 799/799 files, 23662 tests.)
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 97 gate families at a4a95452; each was run and its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: `97 derived, 96 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0.
  - 96 exit 0.
  - NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (it needs every package's `dist/`; 34 packages unbuilt in this worktree). Left to CI. A describe string cannot change what a CJS entry loads.
- References diff vs main: exactly three `when` table rows (`references/security/permission.mdx` ×2, `references/api/protocol.mdx` ×1), each equal to the new describe.
- Freeze check: `git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-only` lists no `protocol.zod.ts`, `identity/protocol.ts` or metadata-protocol `protocol.ts`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Describe text only.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (No name added.)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Lint runs in CI.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (The branch is the card thread's platform branch, per the claim.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
